criteriaSatisfied.evidence: Returned 10 concrete findings with file:line references, ranked by severity, covering all 7 requested review areas

validationOutput: Review complete: no SQL injection found (all queries parameterized)
2 medium-severity issues: suffix/mention regex mismatch (names.ts:145, db.ts:415), cross-thread reply linking (db.ts:286, tools.ts:172)
3 low-severity issues: LIKE wildcard injection (db.ts:246,257), no input validation (db.ts:173,286,330), fragile getDb cast (stats.ts:21)
5 note-level items: unused exports, unguarded resetAll, heartbeat error handling, polling-only DMs, flat thread display
residualRisks: #1 Suffix/mention mismatch: if any pi session ID starts with non-hex chars, agents become unmentionable. Fix: encode suffix as hex (e.g. Buffer.from(sessionId).toString('hex').slice(0,8)) or broaden the regex to [a-z0-9]{4}.
#2 Cross-thread reply: no DB or tool-level check that parent_reply_id belongs to the same message thread. Fix: add WHERE message_id = ? check in createReply or validate in the tool layer.
LIKE wildcard: escape % and _ in user-provided tag/query values before passing to LIKE bind parameter.
reviewFindings: medium: names.ts:145 + db.ts:415 - generateSuffix doesn't enforce hex, but extractMentions regex requires [a-f0-9]{4}. Agents with non-hex session IDs become unmentionable.
medium: db.ts:286-292 + tools.ts:172-181 - createReply accepts parent_reply_id without validating it belongs to the same messageId. Cross-thread linking possible.
low: db.ts:246-247 - Tag LIKE search doesn't escape % and _ wildcards in user input.
low: db.ts:257-258 - searchMessages doesn't escape % and _ wildcards in query string.
low: db.ts:173,286,330 - No validation for empty subject/body in createMessage, createReply, sendDirectMessage.
low: stats.ts:21 - Accesses private getDb via (db as any) cast. Fragile coupling.
note: db.ts:121,270,363,390 - Unused exported functions: getAllAgents, assignMessage, markAllAsRead, removeBookmark.
low: db.ts:400 - resetAll exported with no guard against accidental invocation.
low: index.ts:42-44 - Heartbeat setInterval callback has no error handling.
note: DM delivery relies entirely on polling. No push mechanism exists.
note: db.ts:312-317 + tools.ts:462 - Thread display is flat, not recursive tree.
childReport.manualNotes: No blockers for initial release. Items #1 and #2 are the most actionable — the suffix hex mismatch is a latent bug that will surface the moment a non-hex session ID appears in production. The cross-thread reply issue is a data integrity gap that's hard to fix after agents have already posted cross-thread replies.
